S1 — BLOCKING: independently emitted residual save/payload effects omit their printed recipient/area predicates.
Invariant/authority: USER's faithful-or-absent decision, owning bead .19.4.5 DESIGN/AC1/AC3, the printed descriptions and ADR 0020 source fidelity require each typed effects claim to retain the selected source predicate (including affected recipient and spatial eligibility), or be withheld with its verbatim span. Profile rules-clause-complete; owner .19.4.5. A correct separate payload/operation cannot qualify an independent effect it does not reference. This is the surviving qualifier-loss class, not whole-item completeness or an engine-execution demand.

Confirmed membership:
1. Dust of Sneezing and Choking / c2-residual-choking-dust. Producer packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:917-923; records.json:98826. Printed p. 219: after the throw, YOU and each creature that NEEDS TO BREATHE WITHIN 30 FEET OF YOU resolve the save and incapacitation/suffocation. This independent effect merely triggers on dust thrown into air and imposes the save/conditions, with no recipient, breathing predicate, radius or distance origin. Scenarios: a non-throwing creature that does not need to breathe standing nearby, or a breathing creature 40 feet from the thrower, must not receive this selected save/condition procedure; the residual projection contains neither exclusion. The throw-dust operation correctly targets self and breathing creatures within 30 feet, but references ONLY choking-dust, not c2-residual-choking-dust. A recursive mechanics reference walk finds the residual ID only at its own effect.id; its separate readiness clause positively owns it. The bound consumable choking-dust payload is NOT independently alleged defective.
2. Instant Fortress / c2-residual-fortress-appearance-damage. Same producer :974-980; records.json:106494. Printed pp. 226-227: EACH CREATURE IN THE AREA WHERE THE FORTRESS APPEARS resolves the DC 15 save, 10d10/half damage and displacement. The effect triggers only on fortress appears, with damage/save/push but no recipient or appearance-area restriction. Scenario: a creature standing outside the appearing tower's footprint, including beside it, is outside the printed damage procedure; the residual projection contains no condition excluding that creature. No operation or state binding references this effect or supplies its target restriction. The repaired exterior/adjacent pushTo describes DESTINATION, not eligibility for damage, and cannot stand in for the omitted source area. This finding does not demand adding an independent unrepresented fortress ability or the separate object-damage branch.

Sibling/state-space work: compared all triggeredEffect, imposesCondition and visibility payloads plus real bindings and nested/variant members; varied breathing/nonbreathing, self/other, in/out of area, radius/footprint/origin, independent versus actually bound duplicate, visible/invisible, light membership and receiver versus displacement destination. Dust of Disappearance retains its ten-foot creature/object scope; Bag of Beans and Bead of Force retain their radius; Javelin/Thunder line and Shooting Stars cube retain their geometry; Mace Terror/Pipes/Gem/Paralysis payloads have explicit selectors or real operation bindings. Curse references, worn/wielded general context and selected variants were not mistaken for absent applicability. Two confirmed unbound residual carriers are batched here.

Closure: make BOTH residual effects retain the printed receiver/area eligibility exactly through the curated producer, or withhold them with complete verbatim spans; search the same independent-payload boundary for siblings, regenerate pack/inventory, and reconcile registry evidence. Add proportionate GENERALIZED source-qualification regression evidence for recipient/area loss and independent-versus-bound payloads, with representative eligible/ineligible substitutions; preserve existing exact source-backed assertions. No new contract layer, per-effect permanent test or executor required. This material semantic repair requires fresh full review at its regenerated exact head. Both current targeted greens and exact regeneration reproduce these omissions; they do not close S1.
